name: NGC 55 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 55, an edge-on Magellanic-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc55-hubble
story: Seen edge-on, NGC 55 closely resembles the Large Magellanic Cloud, though it is smaller. Hubble looked into its central part to learn how small structures such as dust clouds dim the galaxy's light.

claims.text: It resembles the Large Magellanic Cloud but is smaller and edge-on
Hubble observed a central part to study how small structures such as dust clouds dim its light
